title: Fine-tuning comparison: teleop-only vs drag+editing vs raw drag-only vs mixed 70/30
purpose: Quantify the value of the hand-removal editing pipeline (Masquerade-style) and of supplementing drag-teaching demonstrations with teleop data, against the simplest baseline (raw drag-only).

arms.description: Train on drag-teaching demonstrations that have been passed through the hand-removal editing pipeline (Masquerade-style green-glove inpainting).

data_source.expected_preprocessing: color-key hand removal driven by the green long gloves; preserves robot motion + object contacts + task state; produces edited mp4s in cam_top_rgb_edited.mp4 etc.

model.head: MLP (3*128 + 64) -> 256 -> 14 (action == next-step joint targets, +state_dt_ms forward)
model.init: random; this is a fine-tune-style baseline, not pretrained image weights

training_setup.smoke_purpose: prove loader -> model -> loss -> backprop loop end-to-end before any arm has data to support a full run.

evaluation.held_out_set: eval_tier_strict_episodes from the manifest (currently 13 drag episodes at <= 0.02 rad stillness)

offline_metrics.name: action_mse
offline_metrics.description: MSE between predicted next-step joint targets and ground truth, averaged over all sampled timesteps in the held-out set.

offline_metrics.name: action_l1_last2s
offline_metrics.description: L1 between predicted and ground-truth action in the last 2 s of each episode; isolates terminal-stability behaviour.

offline_metrics.name: per_arm_l1
offline_metrics.description: Same as above but split between left_arm and right_arm (the right arm is the active manipulator for the spatula SOP).

online_metrics_robot_only.name: task_success_rate
online_metrics_robot_only.description: Fraction of robot rollouts that place the egg mold inside the white plate.

online_metrics_robot_only.name: terminal_stillness_pass_rate
online_metrics_robot_only.description: Fraction of rollouts whose trailing 2 s passes the SOP <= 0.10 rad gate.

online_metrics_robot_only.name: contact_safety_rate
online_metrics_robot_only.description: Fraction of rollouts where spatula contact stays within the yellow gripper region (per the SOP).

evaluation.online_metric_status_today: BLOCKED — requires the physical robot in the loop; not measurable in this remote session.

run.json_fields.config: object — full training_setup + arm-specific data source
run.json_fields.system_info: object — torch version, cuda available, gpu name
run.json_fields.stdout_tail: string — last 4 KB of stdout for forensic value

comparison_protocol.step_1: Confirm each arm's data source is READY in the spec.
comparison_protocol.step_2: For each READY arm, run train_finetune.py with the corresponding mode + manifest. The script auto-tags the run with arm_id and writes run.json.
comparison_protocol.step_3: Aggregate run.jsons via aggregate_runs.py (TODO) — outputs a comparison table indexed by arm_id.
comparison_protocol.step_4: Pass/fail vs baseline: a non-C arm wins if it beats C on (a) action_l1_last2s by >= 10% relative AND (b) online task_success_rate by >= 5 percentage points on robot rollouts.
